handwritten-vitest-shim.packages/node-sdk/test/session-runtime-h: Real polling helper. Bun 1.4.4 has no expect.poll and no vi.waitFor, so an async-settling probe needs a poll loop. This duplicates packages/agent-core-v2/test/helpers/waitFor.ts, but that helper is package-private to agent-core-v2; deduplicating it needs a shared test-helper package, which is a separate change.
handwritten-vitest-shim.apps/vscode/test/webview/setup.ts: Real capability gap. Bun has no test environment option, so a webview suite that needs a document imports this module to build a jsdom window and tear it down per file. A bunfig preload cannot be used because the extension tests must not see a document.
